response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), stats AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT c.PlaylistId, c.track_count, CAST(c.track_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(s.avg_count, 0) AS ratio FROM counts c CROSS JOIN stats s ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average is the mean of the per-playlist track counts across all playlists, with empty playlists counted as zero. Because this equals total entries divided by number of playlists, the result is the same under either reading.
The ratio is NULL when the average is zero (every playlist is empty, so the division is undefined). NULL ratios sort last. If no playlists exist, the average is NULL and every ratio is NULL.
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily, because the request does not specify a secondary sort key.
